audit.why: K'Sante owns 1-3, even at 4-5, Yi takes 6 and first item, K'Sante reclaims at 2+. Chart matches the packet and the two layers agree row for row.
audit.corrected: No change to the level chart.

audit.whatIsWrong: content spikes[1].text contained unfinished editorial text on the live page: 'Meditate (R... actually W) is not your fight button', and then claimed All Out 're-forms his shields'.
audit.why: All Out grants increased damage, healing and transformed abilities at the cost of reduced defenses — the shield is Footwork (E). The level-6 spike is Highlander's 85s of move and attack speed, and Meditate is a 10s channel his Q or W cancels.
audit.corrected: spikes[1].text rewritten; content.mid corrected from 'reshields' to healing.

audit.whatIsWrong: Two systematic naming errors. The full layer calls his Q 'Ntofo's Ferocity' in five places — the real name is Ntofo Strikes. The content layer labels Ntofo Strikes as (W) in five places, colliding with Path Maker, and calls Yi's own passive 'Double Strike (Q)'. On top of that, Q is described as a knockup: Riot's text says it slows, and at 2 stacks fires a shockwave that PULLS enemies in. The knockback and stun are Path Maker (W); the wall-launch is All Out (R).
audit.why: A player told to dodge a 'Q knockup' looks for the wrong animation and stands in the wrong place. The pull and the stun are different abilities with different cooldowns — 3.5s versus 14s at rank 1 — and the whole trading window hangs on which one is down.
audit.corrected: phases[0].why, breakdown.early, breakdown.cooldowns, dontsFull[1].d and report[5].t renamed to Ntofo Strikes and re-described as slow-plus-pull; whys[0], whys[2], spikes[0].text, early, wants.you[1] and wants.foe[0] re-lettered to (Q). Grievous Wounds added against All Out's healing.

audit.whatIsWrong: No numbers on the abilities the trading window is built around.
audit.why: Ntofo Strikes is 3.5s flat — it is never 'on cooldown' in a useful sense, so the real gate is his stack count and Path Maker's 14s. All Out is 120s at rank 1.
audit.corrected: Numbers written into breakdown.early, breakdown.cooldowns and content.mid.

edits.before: His Ntofo's Ferocity Q knockup and tanky base stats bully your short-range autos while you have only Alpha Strike for damage and no escape.
edits.after: Ntofo Strikes (Q) slows on a 3.5s cooldown and pulls you in at two stacks, so his tanky base stats bully your autos while you hold only Alpha Strike.

edits.before: Levels 1-3 belong to K'Sante. His Ntofo's Ferocity Q outranges your autos and the empowered third cast knocks you up, while you have nothing but Alpha Strike for damage and zero escape if you over-extend. Farm with Q and Wuju autos, take the CS hits, and do not contest him — every all-in here is his.
edits.after: Levels 1-3 belong to K'Sante. Ntofo Strikes (Q) outranges your autos on a 3.5s cooldown and the second stack fires a shockwave that pulls you in, while you have nothing but Alpha Strike and zero escape if you over-extend. Farm with Q and Wuju autos, eat the CS loss, and do not contest — every early all-in is his.

edits.before: Track his Ntofo's Ferocity Q charges and his R cooldown — Q knockup is his all-in initiation and R is the only tool that punishes your Alpha Strike commit.
edits.after: Track his Ntofo Strikes (Q) stacks and All Out (R) on 120s at rank 1 — the two-stack pull starts his all-in, and R is the only tool that punishes your Alpha Strike.

edits.before: If you blink in and his Ntofo's Ferocity Q is up, the empowered knockup lands as you land — wait for it on cooldown before you commit.
edits.after: If you blink in with one Ntofo Strikes stack already banked, his next cast pulls you straight back in — commit only after that shockwave is spent.

edits.before: Alpha Strike's untargetability dodges his R isolation and Ntofo Q knockup; E Wuju Style's true damage ignores the armor his tank build and R-strip rely on; Highlander's slow immunity beats his Q slow.
edits.after: Alpha Strike's untargetability dodges All Out (R) and the Ntofo Strikes pull; Wuju Style's true damage ignores his armour entirely; Highlander beats the Q slow, and All Out heals him, so bring Grievous Wounds.

edits.before: K'Sante's Ntofo Strikes (W) and Path Maker (W) stun dominate the level-1 approach and punish any step-up.
edits.after: Ntofo Strikes (Q) and the Path Maker (W) stun dominate the level-1 approach and punish any step-up.

edits.before: Level 3 his full W-into-slow combo still outranges and out-CCs your Alpha Strike engage.
edits.after: Level 3 his Q-pull into W stun still out-CCs your Alpha Strike engage.

edits.before: Your Double Strike (Q) and Alpha Strike (Q) let you last-hit safely, but stepping up gets you knocked-up and slowed by his Ntofo Strikes (W) pulling into a Path Maker (W) stun; farm from max range and only Alpha in for a cannon.
edits.after: Double Strike (P) and Alpha Strike (Q) let you last-hit safely, but stepping up gets you slowed and pulled by Ntofo Strikes (Q) into a Path Maker (W) stun; farm from max range and only Alpha in for a cannon.

edits.before: Meditate (R... actually W) is not your fight button — your real spike is buying Meditate value and stacking attack speed, and once you can Alpha Strike him and burst before his All Out (R) reforms his shields you can trade evenly.
edits.after: Meditate (W) is not your fight button — it is a 10s channel his Q or W cancels outright. Your level-6 spike is Highlander's 85s of speed: Alpha Strike in and burst him before All Out (R) turns on its healing and bonus damage.

edits.before: You cannot walk up on K'Sante — his Ntofo Strikes (W) slow and Path Maker (W) stun will lock you the moment you step past minions, so hover max Alpha Strike (Q) range and only dash in on cannon minions or when his W is down.
edits.after: You cannot walk up on K'Sante — the Ntofo Strikes (Q) slow and Path Maker (W) stun lock you the moment you step past minions, so hover at max Alpha Strike (Q) range and only dash in for a cannon or when his W is down.

edits.before: Around your attack-speed item you get a real window: Wuju Style (E) true damage cuts through his un-itemized base tankiness, so if he uses Path Maker (W) to engage and whiffs, Alpha Strike (Q) in and burst him before All Out (R) reshields.
edits.after: Around your attack-speed item you get a real window: Wuju Style (E) true damage cuts through his un-itemized base tankiness, so if he whiffs Path Maker (W) on its 14s, Alpha Strike (Q) in and burst him before All Out (R) starts healing.

edits.before: Alpha Strike (Q) resets on the wave to dodge his Ntofo Strikes (W)
edits.after: Alpha Strike (Q) resets on the wave to dodge Ntofo Strikes (Q)

edits.before: To land Ntofo Strikes (W) pull into a Path Maker (W) charged stun
edits.after: To land the Ntofo Strikes (Q) pull into a Path Maker (W) stun

notes: Worst page in my slice. Two independent naming failures: the full layer invented 'Ntofo's Ferocity' for his Q (real name Ntofo Strikes), and the content layer labelled that same Q as (W) five times, colliding with Path Maker. spikes[1].text shipped visible editor scaffolding — 'Meditate (R... actually W)' — to a paying user. Also fixed the claim that All Out re-shields him; it heals and cuts his own defenses, and the shield belongs to Footwork (E).
